name: pagenet_only_style_neural
description: The page-network system: five chains, each reading its calibrated detector records, registered on the images and detected again (registration_images, detect.redetect), with the pair of page networks trained on all 224 public squeezes (configs/style_mild_5_epochs.json, configs/style_mild_15_epochs.json) from relit crops; each row decoded with the two-sided public and external (openly licensed text, decontaminated) language models and the per-squeeze cache, its final choice made with the neural character model fine-tuned on all 224 public transcripts (models/neural_lm_clean/all) mixed into the forward language model at the operating point's weight (combo.nn, decode.rescore); ROVER merges the five chains' transcripts.

detector._note: Ultralytics 8.4.186, YOLO26-L OBB. page: letters are letter_px high in a page cut into tile x tile windows (also the network input size) overlapping by `overlap`; the first inference pass reads each view at 1/coarse_divisor of its size. train: chain k trains on the pack, mono1 and mono2 tiles of the squeezes outside fold k of data/folds_train181.json and monitors the pack tiles of fold k; every chain keeps the weights of epoch use_epoch, the highest held-out mAP50-95 of fold 0's chain over 100 epochs (ties earliest); `--epoch best` applies that rule to the chain's own held-out fold. batch 0.85 is Ultralytics' auto batch (fraction of GPU memory). infer: raw detections at conf, rotated NMS at nms_iou, then a registration and a 40 px page per view from the first pass; a view needs min_mono_detections detections for a detection-refined registration. fusion: cross-view weighted box fusion at wbf_iou, then Gaussian soft-NMS (no box is dropped). calibration: isotonic map of the fused score to P(letter), label = one-to-one match to an annotated Rotation1 letter at IoU >= match_iou, fitted on the other folds' out-of-fold detections.

dino._note: Relit crops (dino.crops): squares of scale x the detection side, resized to size x size, cut from the relief of both views lit from three azimuths (trogs26.relief).

lm._note: PPM-C counts of order 12 over the transcripts of the 224 public squeezes, read at decode_max_order. Chain k's language model is built without fold k; pages outside the folds (TROGS-26) use the final one, over all 224 (lm/build.py). open: the counts of the external Greek text (lm/open.py: the openly licensed sources, decontaminated against every public and test squeeze by lm/decontaminate.py), read at max_order and mixed in at weight. two_sided: the final score of a proposed text reads every letter from both sides (lm/twosided.py).

decode._note: Rows: a token's keep probability is 1 - P(none); tokens kept at 0.5 are grouped into rows (organisers' v2 grouping), tokens with keep in [drop_below, 0.5) join the row they sit on within extras.span_margin letter heights, the rest are dropped (pagenet/decode.py). passes: proposal weightings of the beam search ({lam, beta, w}). cache: enabled false decodes every row once with the base language model; cache_ref (per variant) is the combo of the first pass that feeds the per-squeeze cache. gap: letter pitches beyond which the language model's context restarts. grids: the operating-point grid a variant names (decode/sweep.py); combo: its operating point, the grid point with the fewest out-of-fold Core errors. neural: the character model mixed into each row's final choice (decode/rescore.py) at the combo's weight nn.
